binding.task: AR-0031 at the supplied Coordinator revision
binding.project_revision: sha256 digest of the exact project revision
binding.worktree: opaque isolated worktree key plus supplied binding digest
binding.session_worker_lease: exact session, worker, and lease tuple from admission
binding.action: every action repeats the complete binding and has a unique id

lifecycle.recovery: old worker and lease are fenced; recovery requires a new lease, worker, expiry, and verified checkpoint digest

host_policy.commands: argv arrays only; executable and each argument are bounded strings; shell syntax, redirects, pipelines, env mutation, and unbounded output are forbidden
host_policy.tools: must be declared in the grant and carry an exact tool version
host_policy.resources: cpu, memory, disk, process count/depth, network bytes, and wall time must be positive bounded integers
host_policy.process: the supplied process-tree observation must be complete and termination must be acknowledged when requested
host_policy.cancellation: interrupting is not terminal until acknowledgement is observed

gates.offline: no process, provider, network, Coordinator, Git, LLM, or durable-state operation
gates.live: explicit capability, credential reference, network, and human approval gates are required outside this fixture

privacy.projection: bounded enums, opaque identifiers, integer observations, and sha256 digests only

failure_semantics.partial_terminal: not accepted as completion or recovery

limitations: The fixture checks supplied observations and does not prove OS cgroups, namespaces, process killing, filesystem isolation, or lease validity.
Offline qualification is not provider, network, hosted-CI, remote, Coordinator, AWQ, AWG, or UI success.
Live host integration requires a separately approved AR and authority-gated implementation.
